description: Driving, walking or cycling directions between places: distance, travel time and turn-by-turn steps, with a link that opens the route on Mappit's map. Each end can be a town, a business or landmark ("Pike Place Market"), a street address, or "lat,lon". Routing © openrouteservice.org by HeiGIT; map data © OpenStreetMap contributors.

from.description: Where the trip starts: a place name, a business or landmark, a street address, or "lat,lon".

steps.description: How many turn-by-turn steps to return: default 25, at most 80; 0 for none.

to.description: Where it ends, in any of the same forms.

via.description: Stops on the way, in order (at most 8), in any of the same forms.

name: get_directions
title: Directions
